cards.ex: The girls were chattering away about boys and clothes.
cards.exUz: Qizlar yigitlar va kiyimlar haqida vaysashardi.
cards.uzDef: Tinim bilmay, ko'p gapirmoq, ayniqsa mayda-chuyda narsalar haqida.

cards.ex: It was just a slip of the tongue; I didn't mean to offend you.
cards.exUz: Bu faqat til uchida ketdi, sizni xafa qilmoqchi emasdim.
cards.uzDef: Tasodifan noto'g'ri so'z aytish, xato gapirish.

cards.ex: Don't mince words, just tell me what you really think.
cards.exUz: Aynamang, menga haqiqatda nima deb o'ylashingizni ayting.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni yashirib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan gapirish.

cards.ex: It's hard to get through to him when he's in a bad mood.
cards.exUz: U yomon kayfiyatda bo'lsa, unga tushuntirish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir tushuntirishga erishmoq, fikrini o'zgartirmoq.

cards.ex: The interviewer put me on the spot with a question about my weaknesses.
cards.exUz: Intervyu oluvchi meni zaif tomonlarim haqidagi savol bilan noqulay ahvolga soldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir kutilmaganda qiyin savol berib noqulay vaziyatga solish.

cards.ex: He has a golden tongue; he could sell ice to Eskimos.
cards.exUz: U so'zamol; u eskimoslarga muz sota oladi.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli va ishontiruvchi gapira oladigan odam.

cards.ex: I wanted to argue, but I decided to hold my tongue.
cards.exUz: Men bahslashmoqchi edim, lekin tilimni tiyishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Gapirmaslik, sukut saqlash, ayniqsa g'azabni ushlab turish.

cards.ex: He spoke off the cuff and impressed everyone with his knowledge.
cards.exUz: U o'ylab o'tirmay gapirdi va barcha bilimi bilan hayratga soldi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan tayyorgarliksiz, o'ylab o'tirmay gapirish.

cards.ex: I think you've got the wrong end of the stick; I wasn't criticising you.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, siz noto'g'ri tushundingiz; men sizni tanqid qilayotganim yo'q.
cards.term: get the wrong end of the stick
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni noto'g'ri tushunish, xato fikrda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Italy, France, and Spain, to name but a few, are popular tourist destinations.
cards.exUz: Italiya, Fransiya va Ispaniya, bir nechtasini aytsak, mashhur sayyohlik joylaridir.
cards.uzDef: Faqatgina bir necha misol keltirish, ro'yxat cheksizligini bildirish.

cards.ex: Many residents have voiced concerns about the new development.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab aholi yangi qurilish haqida xavotir bildirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki xavotir haqida fikr bildirish, shikoyat qilish.

cards.ex: In this regard, further research is needed.
cards.exUz: Shu munosabat bilan, qo'shimcha tadqiqotlar zarur.
cards.uzDef: Shu masalada, shu nuqtai nazardan.

cards.ex: I heard on good authority that the company is planning to expand.
cards.exUz: Men ishonchli manbadan kompaniya kengayishni rejalashtirayotganini eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchli odamdan yoki manbadan xabar olish.

cards.ex: I couldn't get a word in because everyone was talking at once.
cards.exUz: Men gapga qo'shila olmadim, chunki hamma bir vaqtning o'zida gaplashayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Gaplashish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmoq, o'z fikrini bildirish.

cards.ex: The speaker used visual aids to get the message across to the audience.
cards.exUz: Notiq tinglovchilarga fikrini yetkazish uchun vizual vositalardan foydalandi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrini aniq va tushunarli qilib yetkazishga erishmoq.

cards.ex: Keep me posted on how the project is progressing.
cards.exUz: Loyihaning qanday rivojlanayotgani haqida meni xabardor qilib turing.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir voqealar rivoji haqida xabardor qilib turish.

cards.ex: On that note, let's move on to the next item on the agenda.
cards.exUz: Shu o'rinda, kun tartibidagi keyingi bandga o'taylik.
cards.uzDef: Shu mavzuda, shu bilan birga, shu munosabat bilan.

cards.ex: I think we're talking at cross purposes; I'm talking about the budget, not the schedule.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, biz bir-birimizni tushunmayapmiz; men byudjet haqida gapiryapman, jadval haqida emas.
cards.uzDef: Bir-birini tushunmaslik, turli narsalar haqida gaplashish.

cards.ex: I hate making small talk at parties.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofatlarda mayda-chuyda gaplashishni yomon ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan, mayda-chuyda mavzularda gaplashish.

cards.ex: She didn't mince her words when she told him what she thought of his behaviour.
cards.exUz: U uning xatti-harakati haqida nima deb o'ylashini aytganda, so'zlarini yumshatmadi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri, yumshatmasdan gapirish, halollikni namoyon qilish.

cards.ex: It goes without saying that safety is our top priority.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlik bizning eng muhim ustuvorligimiz ekanligi o'z-o'zidan ravshan.
cards.uzDef: Shubhasiz, ravshan, hech qanday izoh talab qilmaydi.

cards.ex: It's important to keep abreast of the latest developments in technology.
cards.exUz: Texnologiyadagi so'nggi o'zgarishlardan xabardor bo'lib turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ma'lumotlardan xabardor bo'lib turish, voqealarni kuzatib borish.

cards.ex: To put it bluntly, your work isn't good enough.
cards.exUz: Ochig'ini aytsam, ishingiz yetarli emas.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri, yumshatmasdan gapirishni ta'kidlash.

cards.ex: I agreed to help on the understanding that I would be paid.
cards.exUz: Men to'lanishim sharti bilan yordam berishga rozi bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa faqat ma'lum shart bajarilganda amalga oshirilishini bildiradi.

cards.ex: For the record, I was not involved in that decision.
cards.exUz: Yozuv uchun, men bu qarorga aloqador emasman.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bayonot berish, aniqlik kiritish maqsadida.

cards.ex: They spent the whole evening talking shop.
cards.exUz: Ular butun kechani ish haqida gaplashib o'tkazdilar.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida ish bilan bog'liq mavzularda gaplashish.

cards.ex: I think you're misinformed about the company's policies.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, siz kompaniyaning siyosati haqida noto'g'ri ma'lumotga egasiz.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki noto'liq ma'lumotga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Please come to the point; I don't have much time.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, asosiy gapga o'ting; meni vaqtim kam.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhim mavzuga o'tish, ortiqcha gaplardan qochish.

cards.ex: They had a fight, but they're on speaking terms again now.
cards.exUz: Ular urishib qolishdi, lekin hozir yana gaplashib turishibdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan do'stona munosabatda bo'lish, gaplashib turish.

cards.ex: Can I have a quick word with you after the meeting?
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvdan keyin siz bilan tezda gaplashsam bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan tez va muhim mavzuda gaplashish.
